purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/release_fix_kotel_occlusion.py: per-box cut of the two OSM city-wall batches in front of the Kotel face, applied to DUPLICATE assets and swapped into the combined map only. Every box below was recomputed from the frozen source mesh; `cut` boxes are removed, all others stay. Nothing here claims visual acceptance.
lastKnownMapSha256Note: Recorded as matched/not matched in the receipt only, not a guard.

streetsManifest.sourceToUnrealCm: [(x+tx)*50, (z+tz)*50, y*50] (source amot: X east, Y up, Z south); identical to the Kotel manifest conversion (create_kotel_stone_detail.py)

faceConvention: a/b footprint corners (cm, XY); tangent=(b-a)/|b-a|; normal=(-tangent.y, tangent.x) points WEST (away from the building); west = dot(p-a, normal); along = dot(p-a, tangent).

cutRule.unit: whole 12-triangle source box, decided by box centroid
cutRule.rationale: Body boxes straddle the face plane (-100..+100 cm) so their top/bottom/end triangles have centroid west 0.0; removing whole closed boxes leaves no open single-sided shells. westMin -20 absorbs -0.0 rounding. alongPad 80 includes the bend merlons at the edge joints (along 0 / L) and excludes the wall continuing north of Y 17732 (box 783, along 2046 > 1944+80) and south of Y 8861 (box 238, along -280). cornerIgnoreAlongCm 20: the probe ignores the outer 20 cm of each face, where the kept box 238 (OSM wall body continuing south) overlaps the first ~16 cm of the 326 cm edge-24 stub at the SW corner.

probe.rule: Candidates are remaining triangle centroids in front of the face segment (west > 0, along within cornerIgnoreAlongCm..L-cornerIgnoreAlongCm). For every probe point the nearest candidate must be farther than minClearanceCm, and no candidate may lie within westMaxCm of the face at Z zMin..zMax.

optionB.note: Fallback only (flag -KotelOcclusionOptionB): overlay moved in front of the OSM slab; misaligned up to ~19 cm on edge 24.

collateral.statement: All cut boxes have every corner within +-121 cm of their edge plane and along -170..L+170 cm; the remaining boxes are the OSM wall continuing north (Y >= 17732) and south (Y <= 8861) of the Kotel footprint. No other building or wall geometry is in these two batches within 160 cm west of the face.
collateral.keptCornerOverlap: Box 238 (P000, Y 8272..8861, the wall body south of the footprint) overlaps the first ~16 cm of edge 24 at the SW corner and is deliberately kept (cutting it would open a 6 m gap).

limitations: Geometric fix only; no visual, lighting or packaged acceptance.
The OSM wall now ends flush with the footprint corners; the closed boxes there expose no open faces, but the transition to the Kotel base wall is unreviewed.
Only the combined Walkthrough map references the duplicates; other maps keep the original batches.
